name: ECE 5242
title: Micro-Optoelectronic Devices and IC Fabrication
description: Semiconductor wafer characterization using Hall effect, X-ray diffraction, and Photoluminescence; Semiconductor wafer processing using Diffusion, Oxidation, Epitaxial growth and/or Qdot self-assembly, Photolithographic techniques; Project work including design, modeling and fabrication of solar cells, FETs, Memory, LED and Lasers, sensors, and IC building blocks for digital and analog circuits.
requirement_description: ECE 3221 and 4211. Not open for credit for students who have passed ECE 4242.
